transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here today because I've been struggling with these uncontrollable repetitive behaviors and rituals that I just can't seem to stop. They are causing me a lot of anxiety and are starting to take over my daily life. I really need some help trying to manage them.
Do you have unwanted, intrusive thoughts or images that drive these rituals, like fears of contamination or harm, or is your anxiety more a general worry about many parts of life?

Yes, my rituals are definitely driven by very specific fears rather than just a general worry about life. I have an intense fear of contamination that forces me to constantly wash and clean, and I'm also terrified of something terrible happening if I don't repeatedly check things like the door locks and stove.
About how much time do these obsessions and rituals take each day, and are they interfering with work, school, or relationships?

I'm not quite sure exactly how much time they take up each day, though it feels like a lot. I'm also not entirely sure how much they interfere with my daily life or work, as I've just been trying to push through them as best as I can.
When you try to resist these rituals or delay them, does your anxiety spike until you do them, and do they temporarily relieve that anxiety?
I haven't really thought about it or tried to resist them enough to know how my anxiety changes. I just feel a really strong need to do them whenever the urge hits.
Do these thoughts and rituals feel unreasonable or excessive to you, even though you still feel driven to do them?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought about it that way. I just know that I feel an overwhelming urge to do them to ease my anxiety.
How long have you been having these obsessions and rituals, and did they start suddenly or build up gradually over time?

I'm not quite sure how long this has been going on, as it's really hard for me to keep track of when it all started. I'm also not sure if it began suddenly or gradually, it just feels like it has been happening for a while now.

Aside from these contamination and checking fears, do you also spend a lot of time worrying excessively about many other areas of life, like work, money, health, or family, even when there isn’t a specific ritual involved?
No, I don't really worry excessively about other general areas of life like work, money, or family. My anxiety is almost entirely focused on the contamination and checking issues.
Do you avoid certain places, objects, or situations because of the contamination fears or because they might trigger your checking rituals?
I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought about whether I avoid certain places or situations. I usually just focus on carrying out my cleaning and checking rituals when the urge arises.
Have these cleaning or checking rituals ever made you late, caused you to repeat tasks many times, or led other people to notice and comment on them?

Yes, I constantly have to wash my hands and check the locks and stove multiple times. Repeating these actions over and over definitely takes up a lot of my time, which often makes me really late and slow to finish things.
Did these symptoms start after using any drugs or medications, or after any medical or neurological illness or injury?
I'm really not sure about that. I don't recall these symptoms starting after taking any medications or drugs, and I haven't had any recent medical illnesses or injuries.
